hero.name: Moaz Sayed
hero.headline: Flutter engineer building production-ready mobile apps with strong architecture, real-world integrations, and product workflows that hold up outside demo mode.
hero.description: I focus on subscriptions, commerce, operations, maps, payments, healthcare ordering, and multilingual apps built in Flutter for real users and real business teams.

work.title: Products built for real users, real payments, and real operations.
work.description: The strongest proof is production work. These four projects show how I approach subscriptions, commerce, healthcare ordering, EV charging, and high-volume business workflows in Flutter.

about.title: I focus on Flutter products that need more than polished screens.
about.description: My work sits where product logic, operational clarity, and reliable engineering meet. I enjoy building apps with strong architecture, real-world integrations, bilingual UX, and flows that have to hold up outside demo mode.

work.title: How I work
work.body: I care about structure, maintainable state, good UX, and delivery speed. I prefer systems that are easy to extend, not just easy to demo.

building.title: What I like building
building.body: Subscription products, operations tools, mapped experiences, payment flows, real-time behavior, and the kind of mobile apps where product reliability matters every day.

projects_ui.placeholder: Screenshot slots are ready for production captures.

meta_pos.summary: A large-scale cross-platform POS system built for real store and restaurant workflows, covering cashiering, inventory, warehouse, kitchen operations, reporting, and hardware integrations.

features.0: Cashier, sales, refunds, purchases, and return flows
features.1: Inventory, warehouse, manufacturing, and shift closing workflows
features.2: Barcode scanning, label generation, and invoice printing
features.3: Offline persistence, sync recovery, and multilingual support

meta_pos.role: Built complex operational flows, multi-platform UI, offline-aware behavior, backend integrations, localization, and hardware-driven cashier experiences.

mostyle.summary: A personalized fitness app centered on onboarding, workout plan delivery, guided sessions, subscriptions, referrals, and progress tracking across a polished consumer experience.

features.1: Workout plans tailored to user preferences
features.2: Trial, referral, and subscription payment flows
features.3: Progress analytics, notifications, and preference handling

mostyle.role: Worked on app architecture, authentication, subscriptions, analytics, progress tracking, notification behavior, and responsive UI delivery.

volta.summary: A production-style EV charging product that helps drivers discover stations, reserve chargers, activate sessions through QR scanning, track charging, and manage wallet and commerce flows.

features.0: Station discovery with charger availability and connector detail
features.1: Reservation flows and QR-based charging activation
features.2: Wallet, transactions, deep linking, and multilingual support
features.3: EV accessories shop with cart, checkout, and order flows

volta.role: Built layered app flows around mapping, QR-based charging, secure persistence, localization, and commerce-oriented user journeys.

refine.summary: A healthcare and laboratory booking app that supports discovery, cart and checkout, online payment, order tracking, wallet flows, and bilingual customer experiences.

features.1: Nearby laboratories, services, search, and filtering
features.2: Cart, payment continuation, order tracking, refunds, and reorder
features.3: Invoice sharing, wallet management, and notifications

refine.role: Built and maintained core screens and flows, integrated APIs, implemented payments, notifications, localization, and reliability improvements with Crashlytics.
